A incorrectly treats cooling rate as changing the thermodynamic Gibbs-energy difference and then compares retained room-temperature fractions to equilibrium CALPHAD predictions; its cited martensitic FCC–BCC evidence also does not directly establish the proposed mechanism in this alloy.
